categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Hongteo Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of aluminum alloy precision die-casting parts and assemblies for mid-to-high-end automotive engines, transmissions, chassis, and new energy vehicle components. The company focuses on high-technology content products such as engine and transmission precision die-casting parts and new energy vehicle structural components. It also operates subsidiaries specializing in aluminum alloy precision die-casting and metal product manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced aluminum alloy precision die-casting technology, including high-pressure die casting and precision machining. It has developed proprietary technologies supported by 30 invention patents, 162 utility model patents, and 15 software copyrights. The production process incorporates international standards such as APQP for product quality planning and uses advanced equipment like fully automatic die-casting machines and precision inspection tools (CT scanners, X-ray flaw detectors, coordinate measuring machines).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hongteo serves major domestic and international automotive manufacturers including Ford, Mercedes-Benz, GAC Group, Geely, Changan Ford, Changan Mazda, Jaguar Land Rover, Volvo, and emerging new energy vehicle companies like XPeng. It also collaborates with key automotive parts suppliers such as TDK, Valeo, CATL, Delta Electronics, and Minth Group. The company’s products cater to both traditional internal combustion engine vehicles and rapidly growing new energy vehicle markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with production bases in Guangdong Province (Zhaoqing and Taishan) located in the Pearl River Delta and Greater Bay Area, benefiting from regional industrial clusters and logistics advantages. It also has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Thailand to support international market expansion and supply chain diversification. Overseas sales account for over half of revenue, with the U.S. as a key export market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hongteo operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a Tier 1 supplier specializing in aluminum alloy precision die-cast components and assemblies. It supplies directly to OEMs and Tier 1 automotive parts manufacturers, focusing on high-value, technology-intensive components for engines, transmissions, chassis, and new energy vehicles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on maintaining leadership in aluminum alloy precision die-casting technology, expanding new energy vehicle component development, and enhancing product and business structure balance. R&D priorities include developing high-performance aluminum alloy flywheel housings, thin-walled corrosion-resistant photovoltaic energy storage boxes, lightweight transmission connectors, and embedded casting processes for electric drive housings. The company emphasizes rapid product development cycles, project management per APQP standards, and continuous innovation in materials and manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aluminum alloy precision die-cast automotive components and assemblies to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. The company recognizes revenue at the point in time when control of goods transfers to customers, based on delivery terms. It does not engage in subscription or licensing models; sales are predominantly product-based with a direct sales model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hongteo is positioned as a leading automotive aluminum alloy precision die-casting supplier in China with over 20 years of industry experience. It ranks among the top 50 die-casting enterprises nationally and holds a strong competitive position due to its technological innovation, quality control, and extensive customer base. Competitors include other domestic and international automotive die-casting suppliers, but Hongteo differentiates itself through advanced technology, quality awards, and strategic partnerships with major OEMs and new energy vehicle manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hongteo reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.73 billion, a 1.85% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 27.82 million, up 79.55%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.12 billion with a slight decrease of 0.81% from the previous year. R&D expenses increased by 8.35% to RMB 65.38 million, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and is expanding its international footprint with new subsidiaries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hongteo emphasizes high-quality, precision-engineered aluminum alloy die-casting components tailored for mid-to-high-end automotive applications, including new energy vehicles. Its value proposition lies in advanced technological capabilities, rapid product development aligned with customer needs, stringent quality management systems (ISO/TS16949 certified), and strong customer relationships with leading global OEMs. The company’s geographic location in the Pearl River Delta provides supply chain advantages, enabling efficient procurement and logistics. Continuous innovation and cost control further differentiate its products in a competitive market.
